text: Unit test files in mailnews/base/test/unit use test_ followed by the subject, as in test_oAuth2Module.js. Task names within this older suite use forms such as testGetRefreshToken. Do not force a global task-name pattern across suites with different history.
title: Start unit test files with test_ and keep local task naming
